Name: Crystal Drake
Design brief: A chubby sapphire-blue baby dragon with an oversized friendly head, two short ivory horns, lavender wing membranes, a pale blue belly, four sturdy little feet and a curled tail. Three large opaque turquoise crystals grow directly from its back. Wings partially open and visibly attached, no floating crystals or glow.

Name: Ember Wyrmling
Design brief: A squat brick-red baby dragon with broad orange folded wings, cream segmented belly, rounded charcoal horns and a short tail with a solid orange flame-shaped fin. A cheeky toothy grin and little golden eyes. Four chunky feet, warm red and gold colour blocking. No actual flames, smoke or external effects.

Name: Cloud Pegasus
Design brief: An adorable pearl-white miniature winged horse, rounded lavender mane and curled tail, sky-blue hooves, two thick feathered white wings attached at the shoulders and a small gold collar. Four short sturdy horse legs visible in a three-quarter standing pose. Horse muzzle, no unicorn horn, no clouds or separate base.

Name: Suncrest Griffin
Design brief: A chubby baby griffin with a cream eagle head, chunky golden beak, small swept-back gold head feathers, caramel lion body, stout golden front talons and rounded lion rear paws. Two attached compact navy-and-gold feathered wings and a curled lion tail. Proud friendly face, no crown.

Name: Halo Cherub
Design brief: One tiny angel companion pet with a round cream face, two shiny navy eyes, a tiny smiling mouth, a simple pale-blue bell-shaped robe/body, stubby hands and feet, and two attached layered ivory wings. A thick golden halo ring is physically joined to the little swept hair tuft on top. No human adult anatomy, no detached rings, no staff.

Name: Pebble Triceratops
Design brief: A chubby turquoise baby triceratops with a huge rounded head frill edged in chunky cream knobs, two short blunt cream brow horns and one smaller nose horn, four squat legs and a short tail. Navy toe tips and friendly large eyes. Coral-pink inner frill, polished toy-like skin, no scales or scenery.

Name: Fern Stegosaurus
Design brief: A cheerful moss-green baby stegosaurus with a plump low body, small round head, four squat cream-toed legs and two rows of five broad orange leaf-shaped dorsal plates attached to its back. Thick upward-curving tail ends in four short rounded cream spikes. Distinct silhouette, glossy simple surfaces.

Name: Sky Pterodactyl
Design brief: A cute lavender baby pterosaur standing with two little feet and compact partially open wings, a long rounded peach beak, a small backward swept head crest and shiny navy eyes. Cream chest, pink wing membranes stretched between chunky purple wing fingers, wings clearly attached to the forelimbs. Whole compact dinosaur visible.

Name: Tundra Mammoth
Design brief: A tiny shaggy cinnamon-brown woolly mammoth with a huge round head, short lifted trunk, two short curved ivory tusks, small caramel ears and four stubby feet. Stylised fur as a few broad rounded tufts, turquoise knitted neck scarf fitted tightly, no loose fabric effects. Big kind eyes, toy proportions.

Name: Crowned Pig
Design brief: A lovable plump PINK PIG wearing a prominent GOLD CROWN with three broad points and one red square jewel, a playful Minecraft king-pig homage interpreted as an original rounded cartoon pet. Large gently square-rounded head, broad cuboid pink snout with two nostrils, floppy triangular ears, four stubby dark brown hooves, little curly tail. A short rich red royal cape with cream trim attached at the shoulders. Friendly confident smile. Crown securely sitting on the head; no pixel art, no writing, no tools.

Name: Waffle Tortoise
Design brief: One adorable little golden tortoise whose thick square-rounded shell is a golden waffle with a very clear simple 3-by-3 grid of recessed pockets, a glossy caramel syrup patch and one thick pale-yellow butter square attached on top. Cream neck and four stubby feet, happy round face and tiny tail. No plate, no utensils.

Name: Pancake Pal
Design brief: A cute living stack of THREE thick fluffy golden pancakes as one compact pet, glossy caramel syrup draped over the top edge and a pale-yellow butter cube fixed on top. A charming face on the middle pancake, two short creamy arms and two chunky caramel feet. Large navy eyes and tiny smile. No animal hat, no penguin, no plate or utensils.

Name: Velvet Jumper
Design brief: One cute plush-like jumping spider, a single round plum-purple body and smaller attached head with two oversized glossy navy front eyes plus two tiny eyes above. Exactly EIGHT short thick rounded legs, four on each side, visibly attached and splayed neatly. Peach heart marking on its back, tiny happy mouth. Friendly, no web, no detached props or scary fangs. Final reference uses a slightly elevated front view so all eight legs are visible. Model four legs on each side.

Name: Patchwork Zombie
Design brief: A silly friendly chibi zombie companion with a large square-rounded mint-green head, one button-shaped eye and one shiny navy eye, a big goofy smile with two chunky teeth. Squat body wearing a plum-purple hoodie and dark teal shorts, stubby hands and feet, one simple cream fabric patch on the forehead. No gore, wounds, exposed bones or weapon.

Name: Sunfeather Phoenix
Design brief: One adorable baby phoenix with a rounded orange body, huge expressive navy eyes, short gold beak and feet, three broad swept orange-and-yellow crest feathers, attached compact red wings, and a dramatic fan of THREE thick layered flame-shaped tail feathers in yellow, orange and red. All feathers opaque solid forms, no actual fire or external glow.
